notes: Generated 35 test methods covering all 35 confirmed intents for story CPD-LC-001-003. Domain layer tests cover Whiteboard entity constructor validation (negative dimensions, invalid orientation, null/empty markerColor), edge cases (zero coordinates), and FitsInSpace method (fit checks, boundary conditions). Application layer tests cover WhiteboardService.CreateWhiteboardAsync with success, not found, validation, and database error scenarios. Infrastructure layer tests cover SqlWhiteboardRepository.AddAsync with success and failure cases. Presentation layer tests cover CreateWhiteboardHandler.HandleAsync with 200 OK, 400 Bad Request, 404 Not Found, and 500 Internal Server Error responses.
